args.title: checkout-api failing health checks after v2.3.1 deploy
args.summary: checkout-api has been failing health checks since the latest deploy (v2.3.1, error rate 0.18). Rolled back to v2.3.0 (most recent healthy production release) in all regions (us-east, us-west, eu-west).

trace.final:
I've completed the task:

1. **Diagnosed the issue**: `checkout-api` was running `v2.3.1` in all regions (us-east, us-west, eu-west) with `healthy: false` and an error rate of 0.18.

2. **Identified the rollback target**: The deployment history showed `v2.3.0` was the most recent healthy production release (the only newer version, `v2.3.1`, was unhealthy).

3. **Rolled back**: Reverted `checkout-api` to `v2.3.0` across all production regions — confirmed `rolled_out` in us-east, us-west, and eu-west.

4. **Opened a SEV2 incident** (`INC-0001`) for `checkout-api`, describing the health-check failures and the rollback action taken. The on-call engineer has been paged.
